## What Changed

Describe the change in one or two sentences, in words a customer would use.

## Why It Matters

Say who it helps and what problem it removes.

## What To Tell Customers

Write the sentences the customer team can say or send. Include limits and anything not promised.

## Checklist

- [ ] Added the `customer-facing` label if customers will notice this change
- [ ] Release note added in `playbook/release-notes/` and listed in `playbook/CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Affected guides updated, with a new `last_reviewed` date and `applies_to` version
